name: What is the process for diagnosing a sewer line problem?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for diagnosing a sewer line problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Diagnosing a sewer line problem usually begins with a thorough visual inspection and discussion of symptoms. Our technicians often use a sewer camera inspection, which involves inserting a high-resolution camera into the pipe to identify blockages, cracks, root intrusion, or collapses. This method provides real-time video, allowing for precise pinpointing of the problem area without extensive digging, ensuring an accurate diagnosis and recommended repair plan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Diagnosis involves a visual inspection and often a sewer camera inspection to pinpoint the problem without extensive digging.
